overview.headline: Trigonometric functions as angle dependent ratios shown by similar triangles

keyPoints.point: A function means one variable depends uniquely on another variable and changes consistently
keyPoints.quote: the value of one variable in a problem depends uniquely on the value of another variable in the problem.

keyPoints.point: Logarithmic function is inverse of exponential counting times to multiply variable to obtain given number
keyPoints.quote: The logarithmic function is the inverse of the exponential;

keyPoints.point: Trigonometric ratio depends only on angle value not on length of any one side of right triangle
keyPoints.quote: this ratio depends only on the value of the angle formed by two sides of the triangle and not on the length of any one side.

keyPoints.point: Dividing out scaled sides still gives x divided by y with same value as black triangle
keyPoints.quote: Dividing out the “2’s” gives x divided by y, the same value as the black triangle.

keyTerms.gloss: relation where variable appears as multiplier count
keyTerms.quote: The exponential function relates a variable to the number of times another variable is used as a multiplier

keyTerms.gloss: inverse of exponential counting times to multiply variable to get given number
keyTerms.quote: The logarithmic function is the inverse of the exponential;

keyTerms.gloss: set of functions that relate triangle sides and angles
keyTerms.quote: The trigonometric functions sine, cosine, and tangent relate the various sides and angles of a triangle.

keyTerms.gloss: ratio of adjacent side to hypotenuse equal to x divided by y for angle b
keyTerms.quote: For the black triangle, the cosine of “b” is equal to x divided by y.

keyTerms.gloss: value obtained by dividing two side lengths that depends on angle
keyTerms.quote: this ratio depends only on the value of the angle formed by two sides of the triangle and not on the length of any one side.
